identifiedBy.fact: Ossa trip starts at Sigurd Creek trailhead near Squamish (west ridge trip)

otherFacts.value: west ridge, via Sigurd Creek trail

notes: WEAK, peak-level: opened a 2014 trip page (west ridge, Sigurd Creek trailhead); Mountain Project text (no coordinates used) says access via Sigurd Creek trail. No opened page describes the EAST ridge; all name Sigurd Creek as the only road-access start. Earlier pass: Ashlu Creek Rd spur A-200, park just past fork (UBC VOC wiki 2013). No coordinate from an allowed source.

Nothing new. Opened climber.org AdamsPeak.html: west start via Frenchman Lake Rd / FS 24N44 to SPRJCT then Spring Creek, snow decides how far you drive. Search results (not opened) also show an east-side start from Hwy 395 via Constantia Rd and a FS 24N51XB / 22N44 start. Two or more starts in use, nothing ties 'Standard route' to one.

Nothing new. Opened peaksforfreaks 2013 (Lake Sabrina TH 37.213617,-118.610096 via Echo Col, then JMT to Helen Lake, west slope) and wacziarg 2019 (Lake Sabrina via Echo Col, Black Giant west slope on return). But route text calls the Echo Col approach the east-side variant and the main approach is off the JMT near Muir Pass, which could be South Lake (Bishop Pass), North Lake or Sabrina. Peakery lists west slope but names no trailhead. No page ties 'West Slope from Black Giant Pass' to one start. Leads: USFS SABRINA LAKE TH 37.213605,-118.610013; South Lake TH 37.169305,-118.565813. highsierratopix 403.

trailhead.name: Kennedy Meadows Trailhead (Summit Creek / Stanislaus River trail start, near Kennedy Meadows Resort)

identifiedBy.fact: trip report to Black Hawk Mtn: trailhead about half a mile past locked gate near Kennedy Meadows Resort off Hwy 108; trail along Stanislaus River past Relief Reservoir and up Summit Creek, leave trail, east ridge

notes: Re-opened climber.org 1999/414 this pass: trail follows Summit Creek, matching route text. Route is the east-ridge trip (not literally 'Mosquito Pass' wording) but same trail. Placement: USFS Kennedy Meadows Campground; climber.org's own trailhead waypoint (38.3167828,-119.74683) lies about 40 m away, so it agrees. USFS Upper Kennedy Meadow TH is a different point 2 km south.

Nothing new. Re-opened climber.org 2011/1779: Baxter Pass TH (BAXPTH 36.84466,-118.29752), west ridge, a single trip; it describes no other approach. Wikipedia opened: no trailhead named. SummitPost search summary (not opened, site 403) lists Parker Lakes, Rae Lakes (Kings Canyon side) and Diamond Peak approaches as well as Baxter Pass. 'Standard route' is untied to one start. Lead: USFS Baxter Pass Trailhead 36.844705,-118.297612.

Nothing new. Opened two pages with different starts: climber.org 2006/1479 (Cartago Canal trailhead at the town, east side, class 2-3, 10 mi round trip, 6200 ft) and wacziarg 2021 (Horseshoe Meadow via Mulkey Pass, PCT, Death Canyon, 23.2 mi in two days). Both in use, nothing ties 'Standard route' to one.

Nothing new. wacziarg 2019 page (opened) climbs the NE ridge from Lake Sabrina via Echo Col with an Ionian Basin camp, class 3: one trip, same lead as before. Search results (not opened) say others come via JMT/Muir Pass from South Lake or North Lake. Burd Charybdis page 404. Lead: USFS SABRINA LAKE TH 37.213605,-118.610013.

identifiedBy.fact: trip starts at South Lake, over Bishop Pass to Rambaud Creek camp at 10,000 ft, then the ridge; Burd 2007 also South Lake, Bishop Pass, LeConte Canyon, Rambaud Pass, NW Arete

notes: Moderate. Two opened pages (climber.org 1996/106, Burd 2007 from earlier pass) start at South Lake; a search summary (not opened) says SummitPost's route page also gives South Lake / Bishop Pass, with Ladder Lake only a camp/alternate drainage, not another trailhead. Standard route assumed to be the NW Arete. USFS point is 15 km from the peak.
